hook: Beta, ye ticket chhabbis saal purani hai.
feedback: Great pacing and strong psychological twist. Cut 1 repeats dialogue unnecessarily since it appears again in cut 8 and 9. Ensure narrator tone matches the late-night spooky reel vibe.
lines: Beta, ye ticket chhabbis saal purani hai.
Raat ke teen baj kar pandrah minute... aur clock par saal hai nineteen ninety-eight?
Sameer akela khada tha Bhopal station ke platform number chaar par.
Sardi ki raaton mein wahan koi nahi hota, par aaj kuch alag hi thaa.
Achanak speaker par announcement hui... Bhopal Express arriving now.
Dhaundh ke beech ek purana steam engine dheere-dheere patri par aage badha.
Train bilkul khali thi. Sameer ne bina soche, darwaza khol kar andar kadam rakh diya.
Andar andhera tha, bas ek TC uniform mein seat par baithe mile.
Beta, ye ticket chhabbis saal purani hai.
Jis accident mein tumhare parents gaye the, tum bhi toh usi train mein the.
Aaj raat agar koi train late dikhe, toh platform par akele mat rukhna.
